recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, moody portrait of a woman with dark feathered hair and dramatic makeup, emerging from a deep black background, framed by expressive, flowing gold script at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Gold calligraphy acts as a frame for the central face
High-contrast lighting creates a focal point on the eyes and lips
Dark feathers blend into the black negative space
Warm skin tones contrast against the cold, deep black environment
coreInvariants: Gold metallic texture for all text
Dramatic, feathered textures around the face
Intense eye contact with the viewer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is centrally located, slightly tilted, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, highlighted by warm light and long lashes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large gold script at the top, moves down to the eyes, follows the curve of the hand/feathers to the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the left and right margins, creating a sense of mystery.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright gold/skin and the zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely long, thin ascenders and descenders
Fluid, continuous strokes with variable pressure
Decorative swashes and spirals integrated into terminals
Hand-drawn, organic feel with slight imperfections
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'l' and 'd' have elongated vertical stems
Terminal strokes often end in a circular spiral motif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script used for all text elements to maintain a singular mood.
graphicDevices: Small eight-pointed stars/sparkles scattered near the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the personal, hand-written quality of the original.
Provides the necessary elegance and verticality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dramatic chiaroscuro portrait of a woman with dark feathered hair and gloves, emerging from a solid black background. Lighting should be warm on the face, highlighting the eyes and lips, with the rest of the body fading into shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn gold calligraphy at the top and bottom. The script should have very long, thin vertical lines and decorative spirals. Add a few small gold star icons around the bottom text.

verificationChecks: Is the text a metallic gold color?
Are the script flourishes elongated and elegant?
Does the lighting focus primarily on the eyes?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Exact letter shapes of the original signature

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of subject into black background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold text is legible against the black.
Check that the feathers look soft and integrated, not pasted on.
Verify the eyes have a clear catchlight.
Confirm the calligraphy has a consistent metallic texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast dark portrait with oversized, thin-stroke gold script framing the subject to create a mystical, high-fashion aesthetic.
